title: A Secret in the Navy SEALs

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《DealBook》负责商业和政策报道。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的DealBook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zoran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、佐兰·蒙达尼等许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话实况。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在nytimes.com上直播部分精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Navy SEALs were warned not to report their platoon leader for war crimes.
sentences.zh: 海豹突击队队员曾被警告不要举报他们的排长犯下战争罪。

sentences.en: They did it anyway.
sentences.zh: 但他们还是举报了。

sentences.en: It's Thursday,
sentences.zh: 今天是周四，

sentences.en: April 25th.
Dave, when did you first hear about Chief Edward Gallagher?
sentences.zh: 戴夫，你是什么时候第一次听说爱德华·加拉格尔军士长的？

sentences.en: I first heard about him when he was arrested in September.
sentences.zh: 我第一次听说他是在他九月份被捕的时候。

sentences.en: And what caught my eye is that this was not just any sailor who was getting arrested.
sentences.zh: 引起我注意的是，这次被捕的不仅仅是普通的士兵。

sentences.en: It was a special operations chief in the Navy SEALs, sort of the top, the elite of the entire Navy.
sentences.zh: 他是一位海豹突击队的特种作战军士长，可以说是整个海军的顶尖精英。

sentences.en: Dave Phillips covers the military for the Times.
sentences.zh: 戴夫·菲利普斯为《时报》报道军事新闻。

sentences.en: And even within the SEALs, this guy, Eddie Gallagher, was a big deal.
sentences.zh: 即使在海豹突击队内部，埃迪·加拉格尔这个家伙也是个大人物。

sentences.en: He'd been in for almost 20 years.
sentences.zh: 他已经在队里待了近20年了。

sentences.en: And in that time, he had qualified for everything pretty much that you possibly could.
sentences.zh: 在那段时间里，他几乎获得了所有可能的资格认证。

sentences.en: He was repeatedly awarded medals for heroic actions.
sentences.zh: 他因英勇行为多次获得勋章。

sentences.en: He was an expert medic, a crack sniper,
sentences.zh: 他是一位专家级医护兵、顶尖狙击手，

sentences.en: expert in explosives.
sentences.zh: 还是爆炸物专家。

sentences.en: He had been a trainer at the SEALs Bud School, you know, literally the guy who's yelling at you while he's making you crawl through the surf.
sentences.zh: 他曾是海豹突击队基础水下爆破训练学校的教官，你知道的，就是那种在你被迫在海浪中爬行时对你大吼大叫的家伙。

sentences.en: And he had this reputation among
sentences.zh: 他在海豹突击队中享有声誉，

sentences.en: SEALs as this real hard-charging warrior, respected, loved.
sentences.zh: 被视为一个真正冲锋陷阵的战士，受人尊敬和爱戴。

sentences.en: So to see him suddenly arrested was really something.
sentences.zh: 所以看到他突然被捕，真的很让人震惊。

sentences.en: And Dave, what were the accusations against Chief Gallagher?
sentences.zh: 戴夫，针对加拉格尔军士长的指控是什么？

sentences.en: What the people in the platoon say is that when they deployed to Iraq in 2017, he kind of went off the rails.
sentences.zh: 排里的人说，当他们2017年部署到伊拉克时，他有点失控了。

sentences.en: He spent most of his time in a hidden sniper perch, where he would fire five or 10 times as much as other snipers.
sentences.zh: 他大部分时间都待在一个隐蔽的狙击点，开火次数是其他狙击手的五到十倍。

sentences.en: They say he would shoot indiscriminately at civilians in the city.
sentences.zh: 他们说他会不分青红皂白地向城里的平民开枪。

sentences.en: At one point, he shot a girl who was wearing a flowered hijab who was going down to the river with friends.
sentences.zh: 有一次，他射杀了一个穿着花头巾、正和朋友去河边的女孩。

sentences.en: And other SEALs, through their scopes, saw the body carried off by the other girls.
sentences.zh: 其他海豹突击队员通过瞄准镜看到了女孩的尸体被其他人抬走。

sentences.en: And in another case, he shot an old man, they say, and that man collapsed.
sentences.zh: 还有一次，他们说他射杀了一位老人，那个人倒下了。

sentences.en: This is just an old man walking down the street.
sentences.zh: 那只是一个走在街上的老人。

sentences.en: And that's what they say.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们所说的。

sentences.en: I mean, this is a war zone, but it's also a place where millions of people live.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是战区，但也是数百万人的居住地。

sentences.en: And so that was common.
sentences.zh: 所以这种情况很常见。

sentences.en: And in fact, the SEALs say that they grew so concerned about him firing at civilians that they would regularly fire warning shots, you know, sometimes only a meter or
sentences.zh: 事实上，海豹突击队员说他们对他向平民开火感到非常担忧，以至于他们会经常进行警告性射击，你知道的，有时离平民只有一两米，

sentences.en: two from civilians to scare them away so that their chief wouldn't have a clear shot.
sentences.zh: 为了把他们吓跑，这样他们的军士长就不会有清晰的射击目标。

sentences.en: And then in May of last year, something else happened.
sentences.zh: 然后去年五月，又发生了另一件事。

sentences.en: They were behind the lines during a battle where the Iraqi special forces were fighting ISIS fighters.
sentences.zh: 当时他们在一场战斗的后方，伊拉克特种部队正在与ISIS武装分子作战。

sentences.en: And during this fight, an ISIS fighter was wounded in the leg and he was brought back a little ways behind the enemy lines.
sentences.zh: 战斗中，一名ISIS武装分子腿部受伤，被带到了敌后方不远处。

sentences.en: This is a kid who was somewhere between 14 and 17 years old.
sentences.zh: 这是一个年龄在14到17岁之间的孩子。

sentences.en: He was conscious at the time.
sentences.zh: 他当时还有意识。

sentences.en: He was even able to be interviewed by a journalist that was there.
sentences.zh: 他甚至还能接受在场记者的采访。

sentences.en: Then he was brought to the SEALs.
sentences.zh: 随后他被带到了海豹突击队那里。

sentences.en: And the SEALs say they put him on the ground and started giving him medical care.
sentences.zh: 海豹突击队员说他们把他放在地上，开始对他进行医疗救治。

sentences.en: And what the SEALs say is that while they were in the process of giving this guy medical
sentences.zh: 海豹突击队员说，当他们正在给这个人进行医疗救治时，

sentences.en: attention, Chief Gallagher came over and took out a custom made knife that he'd brought with him.
sentences.zh: 加拉格尔军士长走过来，拿出了他随身携带的一把定制刀。

sentences.en: And without saying much or anything at all, they say he stabbed the captive in the neck and in the torso and killed him.
sentences.zh: 他们说，他没多说什么，甚至什么都没说，就刺向了俘虏的脖子和躯干，杀死了他。

sentences.en: A short time after that, he gathered the platoon together over the body of this dead teenager
sentences.zh: 在那之后不久，他把排里的人召集到这名死去的少年的尸体旁，

sentences.en: and performed an enlistment ceremony while someone from the platoon took photographs.
sentences.zh: 并举行了一场入伍宣誓仪式，同时排里有人拍了照片。

sentences.en: This is a ceremony where every so often you have to voluntarily re-enlist, raise your right hand and swear to uphold the constitution.
sentences.zh: 这是一个仪式，你每隔一段时间就必须自愿重新入伍，举起右手宣誓维护宪法。

sentences.en: And Chief Gallagher, he wanted to do it over the body of this dead ISIS fighter.
sentences.zh: 而加拉格尔军士长，他想在这一具死去的ISIS武装分子尸体上进行这个仪式。

sentences.en: And Dave, what are you thinking when you hear these gruesome accusations against Chief Gallagher?
sentences.zh: 戴夫，当你听到这些针对加拉格尔军士长的可怕指控时，你在想什么？

sentences.en: What I thought at first was, look, here's a guy with an exemplary record as a sailor.
sentences.zh: 我起初想的是，看，这是一个作为水兵有着模范记录的人。

sentences.en: Here's a guy who's done eight deployments since 2001.
sentences.zh: 这是一个自2001年以来执行过八次部署任务的人。

sentences.en: And my first inclination was maybe so many deployments had left him with post-traumatic stress disorder or a traumatic brain injury or all of the above.
sentences.zh: 我最初的倾向是，也许这么多次的部署让他患上了创伤后应激障碍、创伤性脑损伤，或者以上皆有。

sentences.en: And if that was true, I thought that was a really important story to tell.
sentences.zh: 如果这是真的，我认为这是一个非常重要的故事。

sentences.en: So what I did is I reached out to his family.
sentences.zh: 所以我联系了他的家人。

sentences.en: I spoke to his brother.
sentences.zh: 我和他的兄弟谈过。

sentences.en: I spoke to his wife and I spoke at length about his record, trying to parse out, were there things that had
sentences.zh: 我和他的妻子谈过，我们详细讨论了他的记录，试图分析过去是否发生过某些事情，

sentences.en: happened in the past that might contribute to this idea that he was injured and that the seals had failed to see that.
sentences.zh: 可能导致他受伤，而海豹突击队未能察觉到这一点。

sentences.en: And the family said emphatically, no, that's not what's going on here.
sentences.zh: 他的家人断然否认，说事情并非如此。

sentences.en: And they told me a really startling story.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉我一个非常令人震惊的故事。

sentences.en: They said, what's going on here is that Eddie's men turned on him and they wanted to get rid of him.
sentences.zh: 他们说，事实是埃迪的手下背叛了他，他们想除掉他。

sentences.en: And so they started concocting lies.
sentences.zh: 于是他们开始编造谎言。

sentences.en: First, it was just stealing snacks.
sentences.zh: 起初只是偷吃零食。

sentences.en: And then it was bad leadership and bad tactics.
sentences.zh: 后来变成了领导能力差和战术失误。

sentences.en: And when they realized that their small lies weren't enough to get rid of him, they started making up stories about even worse things that he did.
sentences.zh: 当他们意识到小谎言不足以除掉他时，他们开始编造关于他做过更糟糕事情的故事。

sentences.en: Eventually, it was that he had murdered people.
sentences.zh: 最终，变成了他杀过人。

sentences.en: So while the members of the platoon are leveling these extremely serious accusations of war crimes
sentences.zh: 所以，当排里的成员对加拉格尔军士长提出这些极其严重的战争罪指控时，

sentences.en: against Chief Gallagher, in the telling of his wife and family, they have concocted these stories
sentences.zh: 在他的妻子和家人看来，他们编造这些故事是因为他们恨他，

sentences.en: because they hate him and they want to ruin his career and they don't want him to be their chief.
sentences.zh: 想毁掉他的职业生涯，不想让他当他们的军士长。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: What they say is that he is such a demanding leader, so tough on them, such a warrior that they can't hack it and they've come up with a plan to get rid of him.
sentences.zh: 他们说他是一个要求极高的领导，对他们非常严厉，是一个真正的战士，他们受不了，所以想出了一个除掉他的计划。

sentences.en: And they don't just say this to me.
sentences.zh: 而且他们不只是对我这么说。

sentences.en: There's no way to describe what it looks like to be maliciously lied about, to be at the end of a game of telephone that now has resulted in my husband's life is on the line.
sentences.zh: 无法形容被恶意诽谤是什么感觉，就像处于一场传话游戏的末端，现在导致我丈夫的生命危在旦夕。

sentences.en: They start talking to local TV news in San Diego, where all the SEALs are based.
sentences.zh: 他们开始向圣地亚哥的当地电视新闻台爆料，那里是所有海豹突击队的基地。

sentences.en: And for something like this to have been perpetrated against him and his family is nothing less than disgusting.
sentences.zh: 像这样对他和他的家人进行迫害，简直令人作呕。

sentences.en: And then to national news.
sentences.zh: 然后又上了全国新闻。

sentences.en: If you want to know what a real Navy SEAL is like, look at someone like Eddie who literally just faced down death.
sentences.zh: 如果你想知道真正的海豹突击队员是什么样，看看像埃迪这样真正面对过死亡的人。

sentences.en: And go repeatedly on Fox News.
sentences.zh: 他们还多次上福克斯新闻。

sentences.en: They made up stories to cast dispersions and these stories were swallowed whole by a prosecutor who had no idea what he was doing.
sentences.zh: 他们编造故事来抹黑他，而这些故事被一个根本不知道自己在做什么的检察官全盘接受了。

sentences.en: And really portrayed the chief as a hero who's being wrongfully targeted by, you know, the very government that he swore to serve.
sentences.zh: 并真正把这位军士长描绘成一个英雄，却被他誓死效忠的政府错误地针对。

sentences.en: Is that the way you treat a decorated Navy SEAL?
sentences.zh: 这就是你们对待一位受勋海豹突击队员的方式吗？

sentences.en: It's preposterous, Brian.
sentences.zh: 这太荒谬了，布莱恩。

sentences.en: And before long, they find an ally in Republican Congressman Duncan Hunter.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，他们找到了共和党众议员邓肯·亨特作为盟友。

sentences.en: You have a malicious prosecution that can use every dirty trick in the book to try to get their point across.
sentences.zh: 你们有一场恶意的起诉，可以使用书中所有卑鄙的手段来试图达到目的。

sentences.en: Who's also a military veteran.
sentences.zh: 他也是一名退伍军人。

sentences.en: So even if everything that the prosecution said is true, so let's say that Chief Gallagher killed a verified, designated ISIS combatant.
sentences.zh: 所以即使检察官所说的一切都是真的，假设加拉格尔军士长杀了一名经过核实的、指定的ISIS战斗人员。

sentences.en: My answer is, so what?
sentences.zh: 我的回答是，那又怎样？

sentences.en: That's his job.
sentences.zh: 那是他的工作。

sentences.en: And he starts agitating that the chief is being mistreated.
sentences.zh: 他开始煽动说军士长受到了虐待。

sentences.en: And soon he and the family get the support of first a handful of other congressmen and then
sentences.zh: 很快，他和加拉格尔一家得到了支持，起初是少数其他国会议员，然后是

sentences.en: 40 congressmen who sign a letter saying that the chief must be released before trial so that he can defend himself.
sentences.zh: 40名国会议员签署了一封信，要求在审判前释放军士长，以便他能为自己辩护。

sentences.en: Well, we need the intervention of the president of the United States, sadly.
sentences.zh: 好吧，遗憾的是，我们需要美国总统的干预。

sentences.en: Please review that letter.
sentences.zh: 请审阅那封信。

sentences.en: What is happening here isn't right.
sentences.zh: 这里发生的事情是不对的。

sentences.en: And we need help.
sentences.zh: 我们需要帮助。

sentences.en: This entire system is broken.
sentences.zh: 整个系统都坏了。

sentences.en: And so that's why we're calling on the president of the United States to fix it.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是为什么我们呼吁美国总统来解决这个问题。

sentences.en: And at the end of March, Trump tweeted, in honor of his past service to our country, Navy
sentences.zh: 三月底，特朗普发推文说，为了表彰他过去为我们国家所做的贡献，海军

sentences.en: SEAL Eddie Gallagher will soon be moved to less restrictive confinement while he awaits his day in court.
sentences.zh: 海豹突击队员埃迪·加拉格尔很快将被转移到限制较少的拘留所，等待他的法庭审判。

sentences.en: Process should move quickly.
sentences.zh: 程序应该迅速推进。

sentences.en: So a couple hours later, Eddie Gallagher, who's been sitting in the Navy brig for months,
sentences.zh: 几个小时后，已经在海军监狱里待了几个月的埃迪·加拉格尔，

sentences.en: is moved to a much less restrictive environment at a Navy hospital in San Diego, where he awaits his court martial trial in May.
sentences.zh: 被转移到了圣地亚哥一家海军医院里限制较少的环境中，等待五月份的军事法庭审判。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, while all this is going on with the family defending him in the press, I get this
sentences.zh: 与此同时，当这一切都在发生，家人在媒体上为他辩护时，我收到了一叠

sentences.en: thick stack of confidential documents that show this case is way more complicated than either the family's story or the platoon's allegations.
sentences.zh: 厚厚的机密文件，显示这个案件比家人的说法或排里的指控要复杂得多。

sentences.en: And what kind of documents do you suddenly have?
sentences.zh: 你突然得到了什么样的文件？

sentences.en: It's summaries of interviews with more than a dozen SEALs.
sentences.zh: 那是对十几名海豹突击队员的采访摘要。

sentences.en: It is background information on previous things that the chief was alleged to have done and we had known nothing about.
sentences.zh: 这是关于军士长被指控做过的以前事情的背景信息，而我们对此一无所知。

sentences.en: And it is hundreds of text messages between Chief Gallagher and other SEALs that were seized when his phone was taken when he was arrested.
sentences.zh: 还有数百条加拉格尔军士长与其他海豹突击队员之间的短信，这些短信是在他被捕时手机被没收后获取的。

sentences.en: This is the type of stuff that we never get to see.
sentences.zh: 这是我们通常永远无法看到的东西。

sentences.en: And what story do these documents tell you?
sentences.zh: 这些文件告诉你什么故事？

sentences.en: What are you finding?
sentences.zh: 你发现了什么？

sentences.en: Well, for a long time, the SEALs have had a growing reputation as the most elite commandos in the United States military, right?
sentences.zh: 嗯，长期以来，海豹突击队作为美国军队中最精锐的突击队，声誉日益增长，对吧？

sentences.en: These are the guys who killed Osama bin Laden.
sentences.zh: 这些人是杀死奥萨马·本·拉登的人。

sentences.en: And so we know that they are this very special and secretive commando organization deployed all over the world.
sentences.zh: 所以我们知道他们是一个部署在世界各地的非常特殊和隐秘的突击组织。

sentences.en: And they have limited oversight because of this special mission that they have.
sentences.zh: 由于他们执行的特殊任务，他们的监督有限。

sentences.en: Because of that, there's this subculture that has grown up within the SEALs.
sentences.zh: 正因为如此，海豹突击队内部形成了一种亚文化。

sentences.en: Some people call them the salts.
sentences.zh: 有些人称他们为“盐巴”。

sentences.en: Other people call them the pirates.
sentences.zh: 其他人称他们为“海盗”。

sentences.en: But we're talking about these roguish warfighters, the guys who've really been there and done the stuff.
sentences.zh: 但我们说的是这些粗野的战士，那些真正经历过并完成过任务的人。

sentences.en: And those people are really prized in this culture.
sentences.zh: 这些人在这种文化中非常受推崇。

sentences.en: You know, it is a culture of warfighters.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是一种战士文化。

sentences.en: And they celebrate toughness.
sentences.zh: 他们崇尚强硬。

sentences.en: And they celebrate killing in ways that I think a lot of us would find kind of shocking.
sentences.zh: 他们以一种我认为我们许多人会觉得相当令人震惊的方式来庆祝杀戮。

sentences.en: And to a certain extent, they care less about the rules than they do about getting things done.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，他们不在乎规则，只在乎把事情做成。

sentences.en: And they will cover for each other when necessary.
sentences.zh: 必要时他们会互相包庇。

sentences.en: And these documents prove that that pirate culture is there.
sentences.zh: 这些文件证明了那种海盗文化的存在。

sentences.en: But they also show us this whole subculture we never knew about.
sentences.zh: 但它们也向我们展示了我们从未听说过的整个亚文化。

sentences.en: People who disprove the pirates, that don't agree with what they're doing, that don't think they should be able to get away with things, that think they should be reported.
sentences.zh: 那些不赞同海盗行为的人，不同意他们所做的事情，认为他们不应该逍遥法外，认为他们应该被举报。

sentences.en: And those people, one of the SEALs described them to me as the Boy Scouts.
sentences.zh: 而那些人，其中一名海豹突击队员向我描述他们为“童子军”。

sentences.en: And so you're seeing in these documents a conflict between these two camps in the SEALs, one you knew about, the pirates, the other, which is new to you, the Boy Scouts.
sentences.zh: 所以你在这些文件中看到了海豹突击队内这两个阵营之间的冲突，一个是你所知道的“海盗”，另一个是你所不知道的“童子军”。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And the pirates, I think, would argue, hey, look, war is messy and we can't be tied down with expectations that were made at a desk somewhere in the United States.
sentences.zh: 我想海盗们会争辩说，嘿，看，战争是混乱的，我们不能被美国某个办公桌前制定的期望所束缚。

sentences.en: And the Boy Scouts see that as a very slippery slope and say, no, we need to follow the rules that are given to us as professional soldiers.
sentences.zh: 而童子军认为那是一条非常危险的斜坡，并说，不，我们需要遵守作为职业军人所被赋予的规则。

sentences.en: So how exactly do you see that conflict play out from these documents inside this platoon?
sentences.zh: 那么你究竟是如何从这些文件中看到这种冲突在这个排里上演的？

sentences.en: You can see the schism starting to widen the day that the captive is stabbed and killed.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到分裂从俘虏被刺杀的那天起就开始扩大。

sentences.en: That night, the leader of the enlisted men, this is the guy who's just below Chief Gallagher.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，士兵们的领导，也就是加拉格尔军士长手下的那个人，

sentences.en: He brings them all together, according to the documents, and has a meeting without the chief there.
sentences.zh: 根据文件，他把他们都召集起来，在没有军士长在场的情况下开了一个会。

sentences.en: And he says, hey, guys, here's what happened today.
sentences.zh: 他说，嘿，伙计们，这就是今天发生的事情。

sentences.en: Is anyone OK with it?
sentences.zh: 有人对此没意见吗？

sentences.en: And they all said no.
sentences.zh: 他们都拒绝了。

sentences.en: And they started to plan for what they were going to do if the chief tried to do something like that again.
sentences.zh: 他们开始商量，如果中士再做出类似的事情，他们该怎么办。

sentences.en: And they decided, clearly, we need to keep all captives away from him and we need to keep anyone else away from him who might be endangered by him.
sentences.zh: 他们明确决定，必须让他远离所有俘虏，也要让任何可能受到他威胁的人远离他。

sentences.en: Well, while they're having this meeting, the chief walks in and it's clear to him, according to the documents, what they're talking about.
sentences.zh: 就在他们开会时，中士走了进来。根据文件记载，他很清楚他们在谈论什么。

sentences.en: And what the documents say is that his response was, well, that's how we used to do it.
sentences.zh: 文件显示，他的回应是：“好吧，我们以前就是这么做的。”

sentences.en: And if you have a problem with it, I won't do it around you anymore.
sentences.zh: “如果你对此有意见，我以后不在你面前做就是了。”

sentences.en: And when they continued to press him, he said, well, you know, they do a lot worse to us.
sentences.zh: 当他们继续追问时，他说：“好吧，你们知道，他们对我们做的比这过分多了。”

sentences.en: According to the documents, a few hours later, they report the chief to his commander.
sentences.zh: 根据文件，几个小时后，他们向中士的指挥官举报了他。

sentences.en: Now, the commander is a young lieutenant.
sentences.zh: 这位指挥官是一位年轻的中尉。

sentences.en: Technically, he's superior to Chief Gallagher, but he's also a lot less experienced.
sentences.zh: 从职级上讲，他是加拉格尔中士的上级，但他经验要少得多。

sentences.en: And a lot younger, about 10 years younger.
sentences.zh: 而且年轻得多，大约小了10岁。

sentences.en: What the documents say is that the lieutenant said he would take care of it, but he apparently never does anything.
sentences.zh: 文件显示，中尉说他会处理这件事，但显然他什么也没做。

sentences.en: And so a few weeks later, the platoon comes back again and says, we still have these concerns.
sentences.zh: 几周后，排里的人又回来反映说，他们仍然有这些顾虑。

sentences.en: What are you doing?
sentences.zh: “你们在做什么？”

sentences.en: And the lieutenant says, I'll take care of it.
sentences.zh: 中尉说：“我会处理的。”

sentences.en: But again, nothing seems to be happening.
sentences.zh: 但同样，似乎什么也没发生。

sentences.en: And so they hope when they get home from their deployment at the end of 2017, that maybe they can get something started by going to hire members in the chain of command.
sentences.zh: 于是他们希望在2017年底任务结束回家后，能通过向指挥链中更高级别的人反映来推动此事。

sentences.en: And so next, they go to the lieutenant's boss and they tell him the same thing, according to the documents.
sentences.zh: 根据文件，接下来他们找到了中尉的上司，向他反映了同样的情况。

sentences.en: And they get the same kind of answer.
sentences.zh: 他们得到了同样的答复。

sentences.en: Which is what?
sentences.zh: 那是什么？

sentences.en: And at this point, what are these platoon members saying to each other about what they're experiencing?
sentences.zh: 此时，这些排成员在私下里是如何谈论他们的经历的？

sentences.en: And why do they seem so determined to keep trying to report this?
sentences.zh: 为什么他们看起来如此坚定，一定要不断举报这件事？

sentences.en: It would have been really easy for the platoon to just walk away, but they were concerned that Chief Gallagher was going to be promoted and put in even more responsibility than he
sentences.zh: 对排里的人来说，直接走开其实很容易，但他们担心加拉格尔中士会被晋升，承担比他

sentences.en: had been in as their platoon leader.
sentences.zh: 担任排长时更大的责任。

sentences.en: They thought he might be in charge of several platoons or in charge of training other people to go to places like Iraq.
sentences.zh: 他们认为他可能会负责指挥多个排，或者负责训练其他人去伊拉克等地。

sentences.en: And so in March of 2018, they called this confidential meeting where they got their troop commander,
sentences.zh: 于是，在2018年3月，他们召开了一次秘密会议，把他们的部队指挥官叫了过来，

sentences.en: a lieutenant commander who was in charge of several platoons on the team, and his right hand man, who is a master chief, and called them into an empty classroom at the naval base
sentences.zh: 那是一位负责队里多个排的中校，还有他的得力助手，一位总军士长，把他们叫到海军基地的一间空教室里，

sentences.en: on Coronado, where they had this sit down.
sentences.zh: 在科罗纳多，他们进行了这次谈话。

sentences.en: And they said, look, we want to make sure you understand.
sentences.zh: 他们说：“听着，我们想确保你们明白。”

sentences.en: Here is what's going on.
sentences.zh: “事情是这样的。”

sentences.en: He killed a little girl.
sentences.zh: “他杀了一个小女孩。”

sentences.en: He killed an old man.
sentences.zh: “他杀了一个老人。”

sentences.en: He stabbed this person.
sentences.zh: “他捅了这个人。”

sentences.en: We want you to start an investigation.
sentences.zh: “我们希望你们展开调查。”

sentences.en: So this is by far the most important, consequential, serious audience they have reached in their attempts to get this hierarchy to pay attention to their allegations.
sentences.zh: 这是他们为了让指挥层重视这些指控而接触到的级别最高、影响最大、最严肃的听众。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And what did these two senior officials say in response?
sentences.zh: 那两位高级官员对此作何回应？

sentences.en: The documents say that they essentially cautioned the SEALs that this was a really bad idea.
sentences.zh: 文件显示，他们基本上告诫海豹突击队员，这是一个非常糟糕的主意。

sentences.en: The lieutenant commander said, hey, look, the Navy's not going to look kindly on a bunch of lower ranking enlisted guys making accusations against a decorated chief.
sentences.zh: 那位中校说：“嘿，听着，海军不会乐意看到一群低阶士兵去指控一位功勋卓著的中士。”

sentences.en: You know, you could lose your place in the SEALs over this.
sentences.zh: “你知道，你可能会因此丢掉在海豹突击队的位置。”

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: He said, you know, they'll pull your birds, which is a way of saying they will take away this coveted pin that all of the SEALs wear that has an eagle on top of a trident.
sentences.zh: 他说：“你知道，他们会摘掉你们的徽章。”这是指收回所有海豹突击队员佩戴的那个令人垂涎的、三叉戟上方有一只鹰的徽章。

sentences.en: And then the master chief, the senior enlisted guy, he pipes in and he says, you know, the frag radius of something like this could be very big.
sentences.zh: 然后那位总军士长，也就是最高级别的士官，插话说：“你知道，这种事情的波及范围可能会非常大。”

sentences.en: The frag radius.
sentences.zh: “波及范围。”

sentences.en: What's that?
sentences.zh: 那是什么意思？

sentences.en: Meaning how big is the area of damage from an explosion?
sentences.zh: 意思是爆炸造成的破坏区域有多大？

sentences.en: And he said the frag radius of a war crimes investigation could be big enough to pull in a lot of other SEALs.
sentences.zh: 他说，战争罪调查的波及范围可能会大到把许多其他海豹突击队员也牵扯进来。

sentences.en: And the documents say that the SEALs left this meeting with the takeaway that the command wanted them to stop talking about this.
sentences.zh: 文件显示，海豹突击队员离开会议时的结论是，指挥部希望他们停止谈论这件事。

sentences.en: So do they drop it?
sentences.zh: 那他们放弃了吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: In fact, they get more and more frustrated because at the same time that they're going to the chain of command with concerns, with reports of war crimes, the chain of command
sentences.zh: 事实上，他们感到越来越沮丧，因为在他们向指挥链反映顾虑、报告战争罪行的同时，指挥链却

sentences.en: is heaping praise on Chief Gallagher.
sentences.zh: 对加拉格尔中士大加赞赏。

sentences.en: They named him their top chief in the team, the top of 12.
sentences.zh: 他们将他评为队里最优秀的中士，12人中的佼佼者。

sentences.en: They said that he should be promoted right away.
sentences.zh: 他们说他应该立即获得晋升。

sentences.en: And not long after this meeting, he is awarded a bronze star for valor for heroic actions in Iraq.
sentences.zh: 这次会议后不久，他就因在伊拉克的英勇行为被授予了英勇铜星勋章。

sentences.en: Even though those around him who awarded him this would probably have known about these allegations.
sentences.zh: 尽管那些授予他勋章的人很可能已经知道了这些指控。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Dave, at this point, how much does Chief Gallagher know about these allegations and the platoon's efforts to report them up the chain of command?
sentences.zh: 戴夫，此时加拉格尔中士对这些指控以及排里向上级举报的努力了解多少？

sentences.en: What the documents tell us is that though the upper level members of the team were not starting a formal investigation, they were telling Chief Gallagher about the accusations.
sentences.zh: 文件告诉我们，虽然队里的高层没有启动正式调查，但他们把这些指控告诉了加拉格尔中士。

sentences.en: And he was then using that information to try and intimidate the men who were making accusations against him and to a certain extent subvert any investigation that might happen.
sentences.zh: 然后他利用这些信息试图恐吓那些指控他的人，并在一定程度上破坏任何可能发生的调查。

sentences.en: And how was he doing that?
sentences.zh: 他是怎么做到的？

sentences.en: Well, Chief Gallagher had a really broad reputation all over the SEALs.
sentences.zh: 嗯，加拉格尔中士在整个海豹突击队中名声非常响亮。

sentences.en: Remember, he was an instructor for years.
sentences.zh: 记住，他当了多年的教官。

sentences.en: So there were hundreds of SEALs who went through their initial training with him and knew him and looked up to him.
sentences.zh: 所以有数百名海豹突击队员在最初的训练中都受过他的指导，认识他并敬仰他。

sentences.en: So he started tapping into that network of SEALs and SEAL veterans, essentially passing the
sentences.zh: 于是他开始利用那个海豹突击队和退伍军人的网络，基本上散布消息说，

sentences.en: word that these guys were snitches and that they should be treated harshly, ostracized, blacklisted.
sentences.zh: 这些人是告密者，应该受到严厉对待、排挤和封杀。

sentences.en: And that's a very big deal because all of these guys are going on in their careers.
sentences.zh: 这非常严重，因为这些人都在继续他们的职业生涯。

sentences.en: They've just come back from the deployment.
sentences.zh: 他们刚从任务中回来。

sentences.en: They're getting new assignments.
sentences.zh: 他们正在接受新的任务。

sentences.en: And if he spreads the word that, hey, this guy is a snitch and he's speaking out against
sentences.zh: 如果他散布消息说：“嘿，这家伙是个告密者，他在公开反对

sentences.en: Eddie Gallagher, they may find themselves unwelcome in all sorts of coveted career fields.
sentences.zh: 埃迪·加拉格尔”，他们可能会发现自己在各种令人向往的职业领域里都不受欢迎。

sentences.en: So while this is all going on, the guys in the platoon have one more meeting with the chain of command where they walk in and say, unless you report this to Navy investigators
sentences.zh: 所以当这一切发生时，排里的人与指挥链进行了最后一次会面，他们走进去说：“除非你们现在就向海军调查人员报告这件事，

sentences.en: right now, we will go to the media and we will go to the very top brass of the Navy.
sentences.zh: 否则我们将诉诸媒体，并直接向海军最高层反映。”

sentences.en: At that point, the chain of command blinks, according to the documents, and says, fine, let's do it right now.
sentences.zh: 根据文件，在那一刻，指挥链妥协了，说：“好吧，我们现在就做。”

sentences.en: Almost immediately, criminal investigators start interviewing SEALs from the team.
sentences.zh: 几乎立即，刑事调查人员开始询问队里的海豹突击队员。

sentences.en: They raid Chief Gallagher's house.
sentences.zh: 他们突击搜查了加拉格尔中士的家。

sentences.en: They eventually put him in the brig.
sentences.zh: 他们最终把他关进了禁闭室。

sentences.en: They start gathering information.
sentences.zh: 他们开始收集信息。

sentences.en: They even go to Iraq to try and turn up physical evidence of some of the bodies in these allegations.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至去了伊拉克，试图寻找这些指控中涉及的一些尸体的物证。

sentences.en: And the investigation they conducted is what I've got in my hands.
sentences.zh: 而他们进行的调查结果就在我手中。

sentences.en: And where does the investigation stand right now?
sentences.zh: 目前的调查进展如何？

sentences.en: Chief Gallagher's been charged with premeditated murder and attempted murder and nearly a dozen other charges.
sentences.zh: 加拉格尔中士被控犯有蓄意谋杀、谋杀未遂以及近一打其他罪名。

sentences.en: And if he's convicted of that first charge, he could spend his life in prison.
sentences.zh: 如果第一项指控成立，他可能面临终身监禁。

sentences.en: Dave, the information that you have gleaned from these documents and the consistency of the
sentences.zh: 戴夫，你从这些文件中收集到的信息，以及排成员指控的一致性，

sentences.en: platoon members' allegations and the persistence with which they have pursued them all feels very damning.
sentences.zh: 还有他们坚持不懈的追究，这一切听起来都非常有说服力。

sentences.en: Yeah, it does.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: But remember, we haven't heard from Chief Gallagher yet or his defense.
sentences.zh: 但请记住，我们还没有听到加拉格尔中士或其辩护方的说法。

sentences.en: And a lot of times in these types of cases, the facts don't really matter.
sentences.zh: 而且在很多这类案件中，事实其实并不重要。

sentences.en: This isn't just in the SEALs, but in our culture as a whole.
sentences.zh: 这不仅是在海豹突击队，在我们的整个文化中也是如此。

sentences.en: Over and over in these war crimes cases, I think people look at them through a lens of seeing this person as the hero who is trying to do something in war as a dirty business
sentences.zh: 在这些战争罪案件中，我发现人们总是戴着有色眼镜去看待他们，要么把这个人看作是在战争这种肮脏行当里试图做点什么的英雄，

sentences.en: or through a lens of seeing them as a war criminal who's the inevitable product of a horrible part of our world.
sentences.zh: 要么把他们看作是战争罪犯，是我们这个世界可怕部分的必然产物。

sentences.en: Some people will defend the war criminal no matter what.
sentences.zh: 有些人无论如何都会为战争罪犯辩护。

sentences.en: It happened in the Iraq War.
sentences.zh: 伊拉克战争中发生过这种情况。

sentences.en: It happened in Afghanistan, even when facts were really clear.
sentences.zh: 阿富汗战争中也发生过，即使事实非常清楚。

sentences.en: And it even happened in Vietnam during the My Lai Massacre, which is the worst war atrocity in what was a very, very dark war.
sentences.zh: 甚至在越南战争的美莱村大屠杀中也发生过，那是那场非常、非常黑暗的战争中最严重的战争暴行。

sentences.en: We now see that as something reprehensible.
sentences.zh: 我们现在认为那是应受谴责的。

sentences.en: But at the time, there was a huge part of the culture that defended what happened.
sentences.zh: 但在当时，文化中有很大一部分人是在为所发生的事情辩护。

sentences.en: And when a young lieutenant named Lieutenant Calley was prosecuted and convicted, they marched in his support.
sentences.zh: 当一位名叫凯利中尉的年轻军官被起诉并定罪时，人们游行支持他。

sentences.en: They wrote songs about him.
sentences.zh: 他们为他写歌。

sentences.en: And one of those songs became a top 40 billboard hit.
sentences.zh: 其中一首歌甚至登上了公告牌前40名排行榜。

sentences.en: It was called the Battle Hymn of Lieutenant Calley.
sentences.zh: 那首歌叫《凯利中尉战歌》。

sentences.en: But the story we're talking about now is not just that familiar story of people defending our defenders at all costs.
sentences.zh: 但我们现在谈论的故事不仅仅是那个人们不惜一切代价捍卫我们保卫者的熟悉故事。

sentences.en: In fact, it's about a group of platoon members who are very much defying that expectation and
sentences.zh: 事实上，这是一群排成员，他们非常反抗那种期望和

sentences.en: that culture and are persisting in making these allegations in the face of all that pressure to keep quiet.
sentences.zh: 那种文化，并且在面对所有保持沉默的压力时，坚持提出这些指控。

sentences.en: And I wonder if that means that we're in a kind of new era for the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我想知道这是否意味着我们正处于美国军队，尤其是海军海豹突击队的一个新时代。

sentences.en: military and especially for the Navy SEALs.
sentences.zh: 我不知道我们能否说这是一个新时代，但文件中有一个非常发人深省的时刻。

sentences.en: I don't know if we can say that this is a new era, but there is this really telling moment in the documents.
sentences.zh: 那是加拉格尔中士和他的一位老朋友，另一位海豹突击队员之间的一段秘密短信对话。

sentences.en: It's a confidential text conversation between Chief Gallagher and one of his longtime friends, another SEAL.
sentences.zh: 加拉格尔中士在谈论调查，以及他认为这些人是叛徒。

sentences.en: And Chief Gallagher is talking about the investigation and how he thinks these guys are traitors.
sentences.zh: 然后另一位海豹突击队员说：“我从没想过海豹突击队员会在这个圈子里互相告发。”
